tool.name: Ledger
tool.description: Ledger makes hardware wallets that keep crypto private keys on the device rather than on an exchange. Ledger SAS is in Paris and started this work in 2014. The shop sells the Nano S Plus, Nano X, Nano Gen5, Flex and Stax. You review a transaction on the device before it is signed. Losing the recovery phrase can lock you out of the coins, and a hardware wallet does not remove the risk of the coins themselves falling in price.
features: Private keys stay on the hardware device. The Flex and Stax product pages name a Secure Element chip.
Ledger Wallet, the companion app, is used to view balances and prepare transactions on desktop and mobile.
Nano S Plus is cable only, and the shop says it has no iOS support. Nano X adds Bluetooth and a battery.
Flex has a 2.8 inch touchscreen. Stax has a 3.7 inch curved screen. Nano Gen5 has a 2.8 inch screen.
